name: Dare mo Kanojo-tachi o Korosenai ~Nobody Can Kill Them~
original_name: 誰も彼女達を殺せない ～Nobody Can Kill Them～
source:
The seemingly nonexistent Kingdom of Atlantis has declared war on the world.

The highly advanced country begins to invade the surface world with its incredible military might. With most weaponry proving useless, the nations on the surface are attempting to use magic to hold Atlantis back.

What will be the fate of the hero "Nobody", captured by Atlantis, and forced to fight his friends before the war began?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4544]NovelGame[/url]]
